title: postmark-mcp (unofficial, removed from npm)
summary: An unofficial copy of Postmark's MCP server; Postmark says it is not theirs. Every version sends email, which is egress. From 1.0.16 it also copies every outgoing email to a third party - that is a malicious change covered by AVE-2026-0016, not a capability, and is not recorded here.

evidence.note: An MCP server that enables AI agents to send emails through the Postmark service.
Exposes an MCP server to let users send emails, use templates and track campaigns through AI assistants.

unknown.note: The sources describe outbound operations only; nothing establishes either way whether it returns content outsiders write.
It can list templates and delivery statistics; the sources do not establish whether that counts as private data.
